title.narrative: ASEAN-Norway Business, Policy and Stakeholder Engagement on Circular Economy and Smart Cities Solutions

description.narrative: Delegation from ASEAN Smart Cities Network, ASEAN Working Group on Chemicals and Waste and othere relevant actors in the circular economyc and smart cities sphere in ASEAN to attend a series of policy activities, business exchange and matchmaking activities with a delegation of Norwegian companies and actors at the margin of Ecocosperity in Singapore. The project is established to match predefined projects from ASCN with core competencies from the Nordics. The delegation from the Nordics will include companies with solutions related to circular economy. The purpose of the project will be to introduce and present projects and problem statements from the selected cities in ASEAN, to create a unique opportunity for the participants to exchange insights, learn about interesting Nordic solutions, establish contact with potential business partners and solution providers, as well as participating in site-visits to waste-handling facilities in Singapore.
